gaps.explanation: Statement p4 (Statement of Revenues, Expenditures, and Changes in Fund Balances - Governmental Funds) total revenues collected 1,884,074 = General 1,726,585 + Street 132,225 + Keno Fund 25,264. detail[] has the General Fund (p8) and Special/Street Fund (p9) budget schedules only; the non-major KENO FUND column has no schedule: Charges for Services 24,364 + Miscellaneous 900 = 25,264 (added). The remaining 47,205: the General Fund budget schedule (p8) prints it as 'Transfer in' (detail index 3, section other financing), while the statement p4 prints the same 47,205 as revenue 'Insurance Proceeds' in the General Fund column (no fund shows a transfer out). Classification difference between the two printed statements, not a missing line. Arithmetic: 1,811,605 + 25,264 = 1,836,869; 1,884,074 - 1,836,869 = 47,205 (= Insurance Proceeds / Transfer in).
